purpose: Describe an appearance as though an unreal situation were true.
keywords: Plain clause + かのように; Nである + かのように
He smiled as though he knew nothing.
The lake reflected the sky as though it were a mirror.
I remember it as though it happened yesterday.
formation: Plain clause + かのように; Nである + かのように
restrictions: Often marks a vivid comparison rather than a factual claim.
mistake: Retain である after a noun in the standard formal pattern.
